subject.title: gateway install/status hardcodes ~/Library/LaunchAgents — prevents boot-without-login on macOS

question: What privileged macOS LaunchDaemon install/status contract should OpenClaw support for gateway services?
rationale: This decides root-owned plist mutation, sudo/operator UX, execution user, durable environment handling, and coexistence with user LaunchAgents, so automation should not choose the policy alone.

options.title: Explicit system scope with safe default
options.body: Keep user LaunchAgent as the default, add an explicit audited system-scope flow, and align install/status/lifecycle/doctor/docs/tests before implementation.

options.title: Diagnostic guidance only
options.body: Do not manage system LaunchDaemons yet; improve status/doctor guidance so operators can safely use launchctl manually.

options.title: Full managed LaunchDaemon mode
options.body: Add first-class install/status/start/stop/uninstall support for LaunchDaemons, accepting the larger privileged-service surface after owner review.

recommendation.title: Explicit system scope with safe default
recommendation.body: Keep user LaunchAgent as the default, add an explicit audited system-scope flow, and align install/status/lifecycle/doctor/docs/tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal ties steipete to gateway service-management introduction and service adapter ownership.
